objective: Maximize actionable early capture of future movers while controlling false positives, execution risk, Sharia uncertainty, dilution risk and late-entry bias.

researchBasis.orderFlow: Order-flow imbalance and depth imbalance are treated as short-horizon microstructure inputs rather than substitutes for catalyst, risk or persistence layers.
researchBasis.microcapSafety: Low-priced and microcap names receive higher information-quality, manipulation, liquidity and execution scrutiny.
researchBasis.haltSafety: Volatility/news halt hazard is an explicit risk penalty, not a bullish signal.
